defs.name: Cyberpunk: V Character HUD Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a neon-drenched character status panel for V showing portrait, level, Street Cred bar, health/armor bars, current attribute levels (Body, Reflexes, Technical Ability, Intelligence, Cool), and available attribute/perk points. It is the central status readout that reflects equipped gear and allocated perks.
defs.role: The central character-state hub that aggregates V's live stats and feeds attribute/point data to the skill tree while receiving stat modifiers from inventory and perks.

effectors.name: Cyberpunk: Loadout & Inventory Grid
effectors.description: When the user equips or unequips a weapon, clothing piece, or cyberware from the inventory, that component emits the item's stat modifiers (armor value, damage, resistances, carry weight); the HUD recomputes and re-renders the affected health/armor and derived stat displays.

effectors.name: Cyberpunk: Perk & Cyberware Skill Tree
effectors.description: When perks are unlocked in the skill tree, it emits the resulting stat bonuses (bonus health, crit, stamina, hacking mods); the HUD applies these bonuses to its stat bars and numeric readouts.

targets.name: Cyberpunk: Perk & Cyberware Skill Tree
targets.description: The HUD emits current attribute levels (Body/Reflexes/Technical/Intelligence/Cool) and the count of available perk points; the skill tree uses these to gate which perk tiers are unlockable and to display the spendable-point budget.

defs.name: Cyberpunk: Perk & Cyberware Skill Tree
defs.genInstructions: Build an interactive branching skill/perk tree grouped by the five attributes with unlockable nodes, spend-point interaction, tier gating, and cyberware slots. Users allocate perk points to boost V's capabilities.
defs.role: The character-progression surface where perk points are spent, gated by attribute levels from the HUD and pushing resulting stat bonuses back to it.

effectors.name: Cyberpunk: V Character HUD Panel
effectors.description: Receives V's current attribute levels and available perk-point count from the HUD; uses attribute levels to lock/unlock perk tiers and displays the remaining spendable points as the allocation budget.

targets.name: Cyberpunk: V Character HUD Panel
targets.description: When the user unlocks a perk node, emits the perk's stat bonuses (e.g. +health, +crit chance, +hack duration) and decrements the point pool; the HUD applies the bonuses to its stat displays and updates available points.

defs.name: Cyberpunk: Loadout & Inventory Grid
defs.genInstructions: Build a grid-based inventory with equipment slots (weapons, clothing, cyberdeck), item rarity coloring, filters/tabs by category, and equip/unequip actions. Users manage V's gear and loadout.
defs.role: The gear-management component where the player equips items, driving V's stat changes in the HUD.

targets.name: Cyberpunk: V Character HUD Panel
targets.description: When the user equips or unequips an item in a loadout slot, emits that item's stat modifiers (armor, damage, resistances, carry weight); the HUD recalculates and re-renders the affected stat bars and readouts.

defs.name: Cyberpunk: Quest Journal Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a mission log listing main jobs, side gigs, and NCPD hustles with descriptions, objectives, reward preview, and a 'track quest' toggle. Users browse and select which quest to actively track.
defs.role: The mission-management list that lets the player choose a tracked quest, driving the map's highlighted objective and syncing with map marker selection.

effectors.name: Cyberpunk: Night City Map
effectors.description: When the user selects a quest marker on the map, the map emits that quest's id; the journal scrolls to and highlights the corresponding quest entry and expands its objectives.

targets.name: Cyberpunk: Night City Map
targets.description: When the user toggles 'track' on a quest, emits the quest's id and objective location coordinates; the map highlights that marker, centers on it, and draws a route to the objective.

defs.name: Cyberpunk: Night City Map
defs.genInstructions: Build a stylized dark-neon interactive map of Night City with district labels, quest/gig markers, fast-travel points, and a route/objective overlay. Users explore markers and set navigation.
defs.role: The spatial navigation surface that visualizes quest markers and routes, exchanging selection and tracking state with the quest journal.

effectors.name: Cyberpunk: Quest Journal Panel
effectors.description: When a quest is tracked in the journal, receives its id and objective coordinates; centers the view on that marker, emphasizes it, and renders a navigation route to it.

targets.name: Cyberpunk: Quest Journal Panel
targets.description: When the user clicks a quest marker on the map, emits that quest's id; the journal selects and expands the matching quest entry.

Segmented row of mutually exclusive category options; value is the selected option id and onChange emits the newly selected id.

props.options: { id: string; label: string; count?: number }[]

library.description: Single-line text input for filtering; value is the current query string and onChange emits each new query.
Grid-based selection of items rendered as tiles carrying icon, name, rarity, quantity and stat summary; value is the selected item id, onChange emits selection, onActivate emits use/equip of an item.

props.steps: { id: string; label: string; done: boolean; optional?: boolean }[]
